request: Revisit the iOS implementation after physical-device jank and text appearing all at once.
confirmed_conditions: RcpHttpClient buffered pending Native dataReceive chunks until dataEnd when HTTP status was not available and SSE MIME was absent or wrong. Red test 4/8 before fix, 10/10 after.
NativeTimelineFollow waited for onIdle, which ArkUI defers on busy layout frames. Busy-frame regression red before fix; now onFrame advances.

Previous implementation replaced changed Span nodes and had no appended-range fade. NativeMarkdownText now retains a TextController and MutableStyledString; append and style-retyping patches are tested.
Actual AgentMessageRow -> WidgetMessageContent bindings did update mid-stream on the simulator; no stale binding reproduced.

Markdown style retyping previously replaced the changed tail at full opacity. A red regression reproduced the jump; patch now preserves unchanged-text alpha and fades only the actual changed suffix. Seven native inline tests pass; final normal signed app includes this fix and was verified in a live DeepSeek Flash chat on the physical device.
